description: Scan a repository's source code for compliance and security gaps against the chosen frameworks. Use when the user asks things like 'is this ready to ship?', 'are we GDPR ready?' or 'check this repo for security issues'. Returns a Markdown report and the same data as JSON: each finding with file, line, status (Gap or Partial), the controls it relates to, a suggested fix and a proposal the user must approve, plus work that can't be checked in code. Read-only: it never changes files. Call classify first if you don't know which frameworks apply. Results are for a person to review, never a pass, certification or decision.

frameworks.description: Frameworks to check, for example ["gdpr", "owasp-top10"]. Leave out to use lintsure.config.yaml in the repo, or all six if there is none.

path.description: Folder to scan, absolute or relative to where the server runs. Example: "." for the current project, or "apps/web".

name: scan
